commitMessage:
Fixed bug 90140: [quick fix] for qualified enum constants in switch-case
labels

Signed-off-by: sandra lions <sandra.lions-piron@oracle.com>
dslRule:
<!id: enum.unqualified.constant.switchcase>
<!description: Replace qualified enum constant with unqualified constant in switch-case labels, where it is typically a compiler error (e.g., EnumClass.CONSTANT becomes CONSTANT).>
<!severity: ERROR>
$qualifier.$constant :: parentMatches("case $labelExpression:") && subtypeOf($qualifier, "java.lang.Enum") && elementKindMatches($constant, "ENUM_CONSTANT")
=> $constant
;;
summary: Replaces qualified enum constants (e.g., `MyEnum.VALUE`) with their unqualified simple names (`VALUE`) when used as case labels in a switch statement, addressing a common compiler error.

Fixed Bug 269201: [jar exporter] ant file produced by Export runnable
jar contains absolute paths instead of relative to workspace

Signed-off-by: Ferenc Hechler <ferenc.hechler@web.de>
dslRule:
<!id: fatjar.substituteAntPaths>
<!description: Wrap string path attributes in ANT Element.setAttribute calls with this.substituteBaseDirs() within FatJarAntExporter subclasses to ensure relative path handling for file paths.>
<!severity: HINT>

$element.setAttribute($attributeName, $pathString) :: instanceof($element, "org.w3c.dom.Element") && enclosingClassExtends("org.eclipse.jdt.internal.ui.jarpackagerfat.FatJarAntExporter") && matchesAny($attributeName, "destfile", "dir", "src", "file", "todir")
=>
$element.setAttribute($attributeName, this.substituteBaseDirs($pathString))
;;
summary: Wrap string attributes in ANT Element.setAttribute calls with this.substituteBaseDirs() within FatJarAntExporter subclasses to ensure relative path handling for file paths.
